title: Fluid Diff: Side-by-Side Diff Viewer
description: Side-by-side diff viewer in the style of Meld and SmartGit: aligned panes, connectors, word-level highlights. Compare with Git HEAD, two files, or any VS Code diff.

title: YAML DSL Editor
description: The editor that makes a YAML DSL authorable.

title: 文件动态
description: 点击 VS Code 最底部状态栏右侧的「文件动态」，查看新增和修改记录；点击记录打开文件。

title: Nifty Text: Change Case, Sort Lines, Align & Encode
description: Change case, sort and dedupe lines, align on = : , or |, encode and decode Base64, URL and HTML, hash, number sequences and UUIDs across cursors. One Transform list for all.

title: Nifty Rewrap: Hard-Wrap Comments & Markdown
description: Alt+Q rewraps the comment, docstring or Markdown paragraph at the cursor to your ruler, keeping comment markers, JSDoc tags and list indents. Optional auto-wrap while typing.

title: Nifty Snap: Code Screenshots as PNG & SVG
description: Screenshot code in your own theme and font, with window frame, line numbers, highlighted lines and padding. Save as PNG or real SVG, or copy the image to the clipboard (works on Windows).

title: Nifty Markdown: TOC, Lists, Shortcuts & Paste
description: Markdown editing that keeps up: table of contents, section numbers, smart lists and task toggles, formatting keys, image paste, link checks and completions, and math in the preview.

title: Nifty CSS Classes: Class Name Completion
description: Complete CSS class names in HTML, JSX, Vue, Svelte, PHP and templates from your stylesheets, including SCSS nesting and linked files, with hover and go to definition.

title: Nifty CSS Variables: Custom Property IntelliSense
description: IntelliSense for CSS custom properties across your project: complete var(--…), see resolved values and colour swatches, go to definitions, catch undefined variables, and browse a colour palette.

title: Nifty SCSS IntelliSense: Variables & Mixins
description: Variables, mixins, functions and placeholders from all your SCSS files: completion that understands @use namespaces and @import, hover with values and SassDoc, and go to definition.
